overview: Animal Kingdom Lodge is a Deluxe resort inspired by African game lodges. Its big draw is the savanna: many rooms look out over giraffes, zebras and other animals.
suits: Animal lovers and families who want a truly unique Deluxe stay and don't mind a bus to every park.
rooms: Standard rooms sleep four, and many have balconies. A savanna view costs more but is the reason most people stay here.
pools: Uzima Springs is the main pool, with a long waterslide and a zero-entry area.
dining: Jiko – The Cooking Place is the signature restaurant and Boma – Flavors of Africa is a popular buffet. The Mara is the quick-service spot. Sanaa at Kidani Village next door is worth a visit too.
gettingAround: Every park is reached by Disney bus. It's close to Animal Kingdom but farther from the other parks.
pros: Some of the best restaurants on property
cons: Far from Magic Kingdom and Epcot
Standard view rooms miss the main attraction
tips: Visit the savanna overlooks in the early morning and evening, when animals are most active.
Ask about the free animal and culture activities run by the resort's cultural representatives.
bestFor: Animal lovers and families who want something different.
